title: Native accessibility, options, and input audit
scope_notes: Mechanical audit only; no option defaults chosen; no balance values touched.
D-007 control contract (orchestration/DECISIONS.md:30-40) preserved as frozen.
States: present | partial | absent | library_only (tested seam, no client wiring) | browser_only.

frozen_invariants.invariant: Pane system + two minimap modes with transparency/zoom/side placement as options
Presentation requests / simulation resolves / events / display

areas.gap: All native bindings are compile-time literals; no binding map, conflict detection, or capture UI.
areas.contract_path: Port map/conflict-refusal/reset/persistence mechanics with D-007 literals as compiled-in defaults.

areas.gap: Movement hold-based and three toggles exist (Z loot names, I gear, F3 debug) but no hold-to-toggle or repeat-on-hold preference on either client; attacks fire per press only.
Only hardcoded wheel zoom step factor 1.1 with fixed clamps exists; no pointer sensitivity, invert, or dash-distance scalar anywhere.

Pure fail-closed focus reducer with Navigate/Confirm/Cancel intents exists but is unwired into main.cpp and has no integration tests; shipped focus is ad-hoc gear-grid navigation plus the TASK-0153 Esc-close-topmost contract.
areas.rg_proof: rg -ln input_focus native/tests native/client matches only the header itself

areas.gap: Fixed pixel fonts everywhere (13px legend, 19/30px hints, clamped 13-26px numerals); world text scales only with camera zoom, never by user setting.
Good local practices (backed life bars, light-on-dark chips) but no contrast/gamma/high-contrast mode and nothing measures ratios.

Orbs carry numeric captions, loot names render as text, elites differ in shape/size not just hue, actions give text hints; but minimap dot classes are hue-only and player-vs-monster hit rings share identical yellow tones behind hidden labels.
Critical hits add a near-white burst cross (~300ms TTL vs 200ms normal) plus ScreenPulse op; no reduced-motion/flash option or prefers-reduced-motion equivalent consulted anywhere.
No caption/subtitle system anywhere; the only 'subtitle' token is an item-tooltip prop. Native plays no audio today so captions have no source stream yet.

AudioMixer bus volume/mute API is tested at library level but main.cpp references zero AudioMixer symbols - the client emits no sound and offers no control. Browser exposes only a boolean soundEffects toggle, no volume sliders.

Single fixed 108px minimap mode; constitution requires two modes with transparency/zoom/placement options (VERDIGRIS_CONSTITUTION.md:108-111). One production pane plus HUD-disjointness readability harness; pane layout/diptych options remain future work per constitution language.

No difficulty settings exist so aids are un-gated: always-on controls line, objective strip with extraction hint, hint line, quickbar labels. Risk: beat_legend machinery renders in live play only if populated, but it is populated solely inside the animation capture scenario - live VFX beats run unlabeled.
Browser persists bindings + fps/soundEffects/dayNight with corrupt-payload fallback; native client persists nothing except capture artifacts - no settings file seam exists.
Browser resets bindings to factory defaults via UI; native's only reset affordance is Home restoring default camera zoom.

Gear pane, backpack slots, Chronicles hotkeys+Enter, and Esc-close contract are keyboard-operable; D-007 makes mouse aim/LMB mandatory for gameplay so full keyboard-only combat is out of contract. Missing: Tab traversal, arrow selection in Chronicles lists, any keyboard path to quickbar/orbs/minimap; input_focus.hpp Navigate/Confirm/Cancel intents are the unwired contract for this.

12 native scenarios including hud-pane-readability/telegraph-dodge/zoom-invariance with PNG+JSON captures; browser has 9 controls-binding tests. No test drives rebinding, scale, volume, or focus traversal in the native client (nothing exists), and input_focus.hpp lacks a direct unit test file in native/tests/.

primary.state: Elite attack telegraph conveyed only by translucent red cone/wedge geometry+hue
why_it_fails: No text label on the telegraph itself
No legend entry during live play (beat_legend populated only in capture scenario, main.cpp:6223)
No audio cue (client emits no sound)
No colorblind-safe alternative, no option, no rebinding/focus proof
primary.player_impact: Red-deficient vision players can miss dodge-critical windup information conveyed solely by red hue + shape.

secondary.state: Minimap entity class encoded by hue alone (gold extraction RGB(239,208,116) vs red monsters RGB(196,58,48))
Critical-vs-normal hit distinction leans on white burst cross + numeral size jump

continuation_path_content_neutral: Wire input_focus.hpp reducer into window_proc behind intent translation; visible focus indicator per pane.
Port browser binding-map mechanics (map, conflict refusal, reset, persistence key, live relabel) to native with D-007 compiled-in defaults.

Options surface with persistence+reset covering: bus volumes (permille buses already exist), text/UI scale, zoom-step sensitivity, telegraph/minimap redundancy flags (shape+text alongside hue), reduced-flash mode, minimap mode/placement.
Every new option gets a driven-input scenario plus PNG/JSON capture per native/README.md:97-126.
Caption/subtitle seam becomes mandatory once any audio is emitted.
owner_input_dependency_restatement: Final defaults remain owner play verdicts; this audit only establishes contracts and gaps.
